scope: 補齊 1000 字 Part 1、Part 2、Part 3 共 641 張字卡；保留 Part 1 前 10 字及 Part 4、Part 5 的全部原圖，不改動 2000 字書。

generation.description: AI 生成的虛構場景。圖片只輔助其中一個意思，不能取代完整解釋；相同或相近意思的共用圖片逐筆記錄。

preparation.alterations: 僅縮小與壓縮，未裁切或改動畫面內容。

verification.coverage: 依 word ID 及固定 deckPosition 核對全部 1085 張字卡，每份 217 張。
verification.assets: 生成代理檢視原圖；主代理另檢視選用圖片與縮圖，排除明顯人物瑕疵。
verification.performance: 以模擬下載卡住、失敗、切換與逾時驗證連播獨立性，未執行 Android Firefox 實機效能量測。

assets.prompt:

Photorealistic editorial scene with natural textures and lighting, simple uncluttered composition and one large clear cue. Original fictional scene, not a real news photo. assets.reuseReason: The intelligible image was rejected because its wooden joints could not fit. Reuse the reviewed perspicuous teaching scene: the visibly ordered small, medium and large cubes convey an understandable explanation. No generation retry.
